meta_description:
138 likes, 4 comments - bigleemurali on October 5, 2026: "5 mistakes that are silently killing your fat loss 👇
If you’re working out, eating “healthy” and still not seeing the fat loss results you want, don’t immediately assume you need more cardio or fewer calories.
You may simply be missing these 5 fat-loss fundamentals:
1️⃣ Not eating enough protein
Protein helps support muscle retention while you lose body fat and keeps your meals more satisfying.
2️⃣ Skipping strength training
Fat loss isn’t just about seeing the number on the weighing scale go down. You want to preserve muscle and build a stronger body.
3️⃣ Ignoring sleep
Poor sleep can affect hunger, recovery, energy and your ability to stay consistent with your diet and training.
4️⃣ Drinking your calories
Sugary drinks, fancy coffees, juices and frequent liquid calories can quietly add up without making you feel as satisfied as a proper meal.
5️⃣ Moving only during your workout
One hour in the gym doesn’t cancel out an entire day of sitting. Walking and daily movement matter too.
The biggest fat-loss mistake?
Thinkin".
